Security: SSO/SAML for admin console, SOC2 attestation required, option for EU data residency for EU customers (multi-region support).

Ops test: autoscaling behavior during burst, KV cache hit-rate expectations, billing/export format for unit economics.
Success criteria: 95th pct search latency < 120ms, embedding throughput >= 10k/min in batch, predictable monthly run cost within quoted range.
